topic.title: Low-Rank Matrix Recovery and Nonnegative Factorization
topic.area: Sparsity, Low-Rank Models, and Dimensionality Reduction
topic.overview: Many large data tables can be approximated by a small set of latent factors. This topic studies how to recover those factors from missing, noisy, or corrupted entries, and how additional constraints such as nonnegativity affect optimization. The challenge combines statistical identifiability with algorithms for objectives that are often nonconvex.
topic.whyItMatters: Low-rank structure can reduce storage and reveal shared patterns, but recovery depends on how observations and corruptions are distributed. An algorithm that reaches a stationary point is not necessarily globally optimal; theoretical guarantees and reconstruction experiments answer different parts of the reliability question.
topic.evolution: A 2000 analysis establishes monotonic updates for nonnegative matrix factorization under two losses. Later representatives study weighted approximations and robust completion, including a 2017 method alternating gradient steps with corruption removal. A 2026 exterior approach temporarily separates low-rank fitting from enforcing nonnegative factors to improve optimization.
openQuestions: Which observation patterns make latent factors recoverable under realistic corruption?
How can optimization diagnostics reveal when an apparently stable factorization is misleading?

papers.title: Fast Deterministic CUR Matrix Decomposition with Accuracy Assurance
papers.tldr: Safe skipping and prioritization of coordinate updates accelerate deterministic CUR decomposition while preserving the original result.

papers.title: Median Matrix Completion: from Embarrassment to Optimality
papers.tldr: A pseudo-data refinement makes parallel median matrix completion statistically optimal or near-optimal.

papers.title: Partial Trace Regression and Low-Rank Kraus Decomposition
papers.tldr: Partial-trace regression generalizes linear regression to matrix outputs using structured maps learned through low-rank Kraus representations.

papers.title: Supervised Quantile Normalization for Low Rank Matrix Factorization
papers.tldr: A differentiable optimal-transport operator lets quantile normalization be learned jointly with low-rank matrix factorization.

papers.title: A novel variational form of the Schatten-$p$ quasi-norm
papers.tldr: A factorized Schatten-p penalty enables cheaper low-rank optimization while connecting surrogate local minima to those of the original problem.

papers.title: Adaptive Reduced Rank Regression
papers.tldr: A two-SVD algorithm provides statistical guarantees for low-rank regression when observations are fewer than the combined input and output dimensions.

papers.title: Adversarial Crowdsourcing Through Robust Rank-One Matrix Completion
papers.tldr: Robust rank-one matrix completion provides a way to combine crowd labels even when some workers deliberately supply misleading answers.

papers.title: Approximate Cross-Validation with Low-Rank Data in High Dimensions
papers.tldr: Approximate low-rank structure enables faster, more accurate approximate cross-validation in high dimensions, with computable error bounds.

papers.title: How many samples is a good initial point worth in Low-rank Matrix Recovery?
papers.tldr: A sharp landscape analysis quantifies how better initialization can reduce data requirements for low-rank matrix recovery.

papers.title: Linear-Sample Learning of Low-Rank Distributions
papers.tldr: A polynomial-time algorithm learns low-rank matrices with sample requirements matching established lower bounds up to logarithmic factors.

papers.title: Matrix Completion with Hierarchical Graph Side Information
papers.tldr: An iterative matrix-completion algorithm exploits hierarchical graph relationships to achieve optimal sample complexity under the paper's graph and rating models.

papers.title: Nonasymptotic Guarantees for Spiked Matrix Recovery with Generative Priors
papers.tldr: Under an expansive Gaussian generative prior, rank-one matrix recovery has near-optimal sample complexity and a favorable optimization landscape.

papers.title: Online Matrix Completion with Side Information
papers.tldr: An online binary matrix completion algorithm gains stronger mistake bounds when side information predicts the matrix's latent factor structure.

papers.title: A Scalable Second Order Method for Ill-Conditioned Matrix Completion from Few Samples
papers.tldr: A scalable matrix completion method combines local quadratic convergence with well-conditioned internal computations, even for highly ill-conditioned target matrices.

papers.title: Additive Error Guarantees for Weighted Low Rank Approximation
papers.tldr: A simple greedy method receives conditional bicriteria guarantees with small additive error for weighted low-rank approximation.

papers.title: Finding k in Latent $k-$ polytope
papers.tldr: A new geometric rank notion enables polynomial-time recovery of latent component counts under stated assumptions.

papers.title: Matrix Completion with Model-free Weighting
papers.tldr: Convexly computed weights adjust matrix completion for non-uniform missingness without explicitly modeling observation probabilities.

papers.title: Projection techniques to update the truncated SVD of evolving matrices with applications
papers.tldr: Projection-based subspaces update truncated matrix decompositions as data grow, with experiments suggesting improved accuracy for leading singular components.

papers.title: Single Pass Entrywise-Transformed Low Rank Approximation
papers.tldr: A single-pass algorithm approximates entrywise-transformed matrices with compact memory and a sharper error guarantee than the previous three-pass method.

papers.title: A Non-commutative Extension of Lee-Seung's Algorithm for Positive Semidefinite Factorizations
papers.tldr: Matrix Multiplicative Update extends a classic factorization algorithm to positive semidefinite factors while preserving feasibility and non-increasing reconstruction loss.

papers.title: Few-Shot Data-Driven Algorithms for Low Rank Approximation
papers.tldr: Interpretable, data-derived sketching matrices reduce training costs for low-rank approximation, with reported speedups of up to an order of magnitude.

papers.title: Fine-grained Generalization Analysis of Inductive Matrix Completion
papers.tldr: Sharper generalization bounds and an adjusted trace-norm method improve the theory and reported performance of matrix completion with side information.

papers.title: Global Convergence of Gradient Descent for Asymmetric Low-Rank Matrix Factorization
papers.tldr: The paper proves polynomial-rate global convergence of randomly initialized gradient descent for the stated asymmetric low-rank matrix factorization problem.

papers.title: Implicit Regularization in Matrix Sensing via Mirror Descent
papers.tldr: The paper characterizes mirror descent's implicit preference among matrix-sensing solutions and proves low-rank recovery under assumptions sufficient for nuclear-norm minimization.

papers.title: Preconditioned Gradient Descent for Over-Parameterized Nonconvex Matrix Factorization
papers.tldr: PrecGD uses adaptive damping to restore linear convergence in overparameterized matrix sensing while remaining stable under noise.

papers.title: Rank Overspecified Robust Matrix Recovery: Subgradient Method and Exact Recovery
papers.tldr: Under a stated regularity condition, a diminishing-step-size subgradient method exactly recovers corrupted low-rank matrices even when the factor rank is oversized.

papers.title: Small random initialization is akin to spectral learning: Optimization and generalization guarantees for overparameterized low-rank matrix reconstruction
papers.tldr: For low-rank matrix reconstruction, small random initialization induces spectral alignment that guides gradient descent toward accurate, generalizing solutions.

papers.title: Unique sparse decomposition of low rank matrices
papers.tldr: The paper establishes sparse low-rank factor recovery up to signed permutation using the geometry of a sphere-constrained nonconvex problem.

papers.title: Generalized Leverage Scores: Geometric Interpretation and Applications
papers.tldr: Generalized leverage scores connect matrix-column selection to subspace geometry and yield approximation algorithms with provable guarantees.

papers.title: Inductive Matrix Completion: No Bad Local Minima and a Fast Algorithm
papers.tldr: The paper establishes conditional landscape guarantees for inductive matrix completion and introduces a fast Gauss-Newton solver with strong recovery guarantees.

papers.title: NysADMM: faster composite convex optimization via low-rank approximation
papers.tldr: NysADMM accelerates convex optimization using adaptive Nyström preconditioning, with strong subproblem guarantees and reported runtimes at most half those of standard solvers.

papers.title: A sharp NMF result with applications in network modeling
papers.tldr: Sharp nonnegative matrix factorization results show when rank-K network models can be rewritten as interpretable DCMM models.

papers.title: Accelerating SGD for Highly Ill-Conditioned Huge-Scale Online Matrix Completion
papers.tldr: Preconditioned SGD removes condition-number dependence from a matrix-completion convergence guarantee while retaining suitability for huge streaming problems.

papers.title: Efficiently Factorizing Boolean Matrices using Proximal Gradient Descent
papers.tldr: A continuous relaxation with an elastic-binary regularizer makes Boolean matrix factorization faster in experiments while retaining interpretable factors.

papers.title: Improved Algorithms for White-Box Adversarial Streams
papers.tldr: Using cryptographic assumptions and fresh randomness, the paper improves streaming recovery and optimization against adversaries that can inspect algorithm state.

papers.title: One-sided Matrix Completion from Two Observations Per Row
papers.tldr: One-sided matrix completion recovers column-side structure from two observations per row when sufficiently many rows are available.

papers.title: Over-parametrization via Lifting for Low-rank Matrix Sensing: Conversion of Spurious Solutions to Strict Saddle Points
papers.tldr: Under technical conditions, lifting-based overparameterization turns spurious matrix-sensing solutions into strict saddles that local search can escape.

papers.title: The Power of Preconditioning in Overparameterized Low-Rank Matrix Sensing
papers.tldr: Damped preconditioning accelerates overparameterized matrix recovery, with condition-number-independent linear convergence after an initial period under Gaussian design.

papers.title: Understanding Incremental Learning of Gradient Descent: A Fine-grained Analysis of Matrix Sensing
papers.tldr: For matrix sensing with small initialization, gradient descent learns progressively higher-rank structure through an incremental process characterized beyond its first phase.

papers.title: Bayesian Extensive-Rank Matrix Factorization with Rotational Invariant Priors
papers.tldr: The paper derives Bayesian matrix-factor estimators under rotationally invariant priors and provides numerical support for their conjectured large-dimension optimality.

papers.title: Conformalized matrix completion
papers.tldr: Conformalized matrix completion provides prediction intervals with provable coverage regardless of the low-rank model's accuracy.

papers.title: Exponentially Convergent Algorithms for Supervised Matrix Factorization
papers.tldr: A reformulation of supervised matrix factorization enables exponential convergence to a global minimizer from arbitrary initialization under stated assumptions.

papers.title: Matrix Compression via Randomized Low Rank and Low Precision Factorization
papers.tldr: The method compresses matrices through randomized low-rank factorization with quantized factors, analyzing and testing the resulting accuracy–storage tradeoff.

papers.title: Partial Matrix Completion
papers.tldr: Partial matrix completion seeks a substantial, reliably predicted subset of missing entries despite unknown and complex sampling patterns.

papers.title: Rank-1 Matrix Completion with Gradient Descent and Small Random Initialization
papers.tldr: For symmetric rank-one matrix completion, gradient descent provably recovers the ground truth from sufficiently small random initialization.

papers.title: Recovering Simultaneously Structured Data via Non-Convex Iteratively Reweighted Least Squares
papers.tldr: A nonconvex reweighted least-squares method jointly exploits row sparsity and low rank, with local quadratic convergence at nearly minimal sample complexity.

papers.title: Robust Matrix Sensing in the Semi-Random Model
papers.tldr: An adaptively reweighted descent algorithm provably recovers low-rank matrices when adversarial sensing matrices accompany an unknown RIP-satisfying subset.

papers.title: Generalization Analysis of Deep Non-linear Matrix Completion
papers.tldr: The paper proves matrix-completion generalization bounds and shows that a shared nonlinear rescaling can improve predictions with negligible added sample complexity.

papers.title: Reweighted Solutions for Weighted Low Rank Approximation
papers.tldr: Reweighting a low-rank solution yields compact approximations with guarantees for low-rank weight matrices and nearly optimal distributed communication bounds.

papers.title: Symmetric Matrix Completion with ReLU Sampling
papers.tldr: For matrix completion from positive entries, the paper proves favorable local geometry and designs an initialization that reaches global minima in its experiments.

papers.title: A Pairwise Pseudo-likelihood Approach for Matrix Completion with Informative Missingness
papers.tldr: A pairwise estimator addresses value-dependent missingness under a separability assumption, recovering low-rank structure asymptotically up to shift and scale.

papers.title: An Autoencoder-Like Nonnegative Matrix Co-Factorization for Improved Student Cognitive Modeling
papers.tldr: AE-NMCF incorporates an educational monotonicity principle into matrix co-factorization to improve student-performance predictions and knowledge estimates.

papers.title: Connectivity Shapes Implicit Regularization in Matrix Factorization Models for Matrix Completion
papers.tldr: The connectivity of observed entries helps explain when matrix factorization favors low nuclear norm or low rank during matrix completion.

papers.title: Efficient Minimum Bayes Risk Decoding using Low-Rank Matrix Completion Algorithms
papers.tldr: Low-rank matrix completion approximates MBR decoding with one-sixteenth of the utility evaluations while matching COMET quality in reported translation experiments.

papers.title: Matrix Denoising with Doubly Heteroscedastic Noise: Fundamental Limits and Optimal Spectral Methods
papers.tldr: The paper establishes rank-one matrix-denoising limits under row-and-column-correlated noise and develops a spectral estimator with conditional optimality guarantees.

papers.title: Semi-Random Matrix Completion via Flow-Based Adaptive Reweighting
papers.tldr: Flow-based adaptive reweighting enables high-accuracy, nearly linear-time matrix completion under the stated semi-random sampling assumptions.

papers.title: The Implicit Bias of Heterogeneity towards Invariance: A Study of Multi-Environment Matrix Sensing
papers.tldr: In a structured matrix-sensing setting, sequential large-step SGD can use environmental variation to avoid spurious signals and recover an invariant solution.

papers.title: Byzantine-Resilient Federated Alternating Gradient Descent and Minimization for Partly-Decoupled Low Rank Matrix Learning
papers.tldr: The paper develops provably Byzantine-resilient, communication-efficient federated algorithms for low-rank matrix completion and related learning problems.

papers.title: Guarantees of a Preconditioned Subgradient Algorithm for Overparameterized Asymmetric Low-rank Matrix Recovery
papers.tldr: OPSA provides rank-independent linear convergence guarantees for robust recovery of asymmetric low-rank matrices using overparameterized factors.

papers.title: Matrix Completion with Incomplete Side Information via Orthogonal Complement Projection
papers.tldr: OCMC reconstructs missing matrix entries using incomplete side information, with sample-complexity analysis and a solver backed by convergence guarantees.

papers.title: COALA: Numerically Stable and Efficient Framework for Context-Aware Low-Rank Approximation
papers.tldr: COALA makes context-aware low-rank approximation more numerically reliable through regularization and stable, inversion-free calculations.

papers.title: Fast exact recovery of noisy matrix from few entries: the infinity norm approach
papers.tldr: An efficient matrix-recovery method removes extra singular-value restrictions from exact recovery in the noisy, bounded-precision setting.

papers.title: RGNMR: A Gauss-Newton method for robust matrix completion with theoretical guarantees
papers.tldr: RGNMR combines Gauss-Newton updates with outlier removal for robust matrix completion, with conditional exact-recovery guarantees.

papers.title: An Exterior Method for Nonnegative Matrix Factorization
papers.tldr: eNMF approaches nonnegative factorization from outside the feasible region, improving reconstruction quality and optimization speed in the reported experiments.

papers.title: Fast Spectrally Sparse Signal Reconstruction via Jacobi-Preconditioned Gradient Descent
papers.tldr: Jacobi-preconditioned gradient descent accelerates spectrally sparse signal reconstruction with inexpensive iterations and a condition-number-independent linear convergence rate.
